	Implement safeguards to prevent theft, pilferage, or unauthorized use.

	Ensure inventory areas are secure and access is restricted to authorized personnel.
	Maintain logs for inventory movement and physical access.
	Collaborate with Operations and Finance to strengthen security and control procedures.

	Provide inventory data to Entity Accountants for financial reporting and month-end close.
	Assist in preparing schedules, reports, and analysis for audits or management review.
	Work with procurement and operations teams to ensure smooth stock replenishment and usage tracking.

	Inventory Accuracy Rate
	Timeliness of Stock Updates
	Variance &amp; Loss Monitoring
	Stock Count Completion
	Access &amp; Security Compliance

	At least 2&ndash;4 years of operational or inventory management experience.

	Familiarity with ERP or inventory systems is an advantage.
	Basic Excel and reporting skills.
	Awareness of loss prevention techniques and operational compliance standards.

	Control &amp; Compliance Mindset
	Integrity &amp; Confidentiality
	Meticulous and Detail-Oriented
	&nbsp;Organized &amp; Structured
	Professional Communication.


Salary
N100,000 - N150,000 / month.

Engineering Project Manager Job at Cedarcrest Hospitals Limited




        
    

        
        Cedarcrest Hospitals Limited was founded in Abuja in January, 2008. The hospital started as a mono specialty centre and was formerly known as Cedarcrest Orthopaedic Clinics Ltd. Within a few years the hospital expanded its scope of services and has become a leading private multispecialty hospital. The core vision of the organisation is to provide world class specialist healthcare services to patients in Nigeria and the West African sub region.

Cedarcrest Hospitals Ltd currently has four hospitals located in Abuja, Lagos, Kainji and Jebba having over one hundred (100) bed capacity without patient camps in several other cities across Nigeria. Our services and facilities span several specialities and include emergency / trauma centre, radiology diagnostic centre, prosthetic manufacturing plant, oxygen manufacturing plant, modular surgical operating theatres, gastrointestinal endoscopy suite and several other facilities that make for a modern multispecialty hospital.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Engineering Project Manager

Job Location: Abuja
Job type: Full-time

Purpose of the Role


	To plan, execute, and deliver engineering and capital projects across Cedarcrest Hospitals Ltd. — including medical equipment installations, facility upgrades, new-build works, and plant/system replacements — on time, within budget, and in full compliance with healthcare regulatory, safety, and quality standards, while minimizing disruption to clinical services and hospital operations.


Key Responsibilities
Project Delivery:


	Manage the full project lifecycle (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure) for engineering projects ranging from equipment installation to major infrastructure works.
	Develop and maintain project charters, scope documents, work breakdown structures, Gantt schedules, and resource plans.
	Stakeholder & Contractor Management
	Coordinate with hospital departments, including clinical departments, procurement, finance, IT, and infection prevention & control to ensure projects meet operational needs and regulatory requirements.
	Procure and manage external consultants, architects, contractors, and vendors — including tender evaluation, contract negotiation, and performance management.
	Chair project review meetings and produce progress reports for the leadership team.


Compliance, Safety & Quality:


	Ensure all works comply with applicable building codes, healthcare facility standards (infection control, medical gas systems, electrical safety), fire safety, and environmental requirements.
	Enforce permit-to-work, isolation, and downtime procedures to safeguard patient safety and continuity of clinical services during works.


Qualifications and Experience 


	BSc/BEng in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Building Services Engineering (or equivalent)
	5+ years of managing engineering/construction projects, of which at least 2 years in a healthcare or similarly regulated environment
	Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to liaise credibly with clinicians, executives, regulators, and tradespeople
	Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage contractors; excellent negotiation and conflict-resolution skills
	Valid driver's licence; willingness to be on call for project emergencies
	Membership of a recognised professional engineering body (e.g., COREN, ASME, CIBSE)
